description_en: Queries instance refresh tasks in a scaling group, including basic information and progress of the tasks
description_zh: 如果您需要查看实例刷新任务的基本信息、 实例刷新任务的进度等信息，您可以调用DescribeInstanceRefreshes查询该伸缩组的实例刷新任务
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-instance-refreshes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --scaling-group-id asg-bp1ffogfdauy0jw00000 --instance-refresh-task-ids ir-adfa1231200000 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceRefreshes

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 50.
Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数，取值范围：1~50。
默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scaling group.
You must specify either ScalingGroupId or InstanceRefreshTaskIds. If you do not specify either parameter, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组的ID。
调用该API时，ScalingGroupId和InstanceRefreshTaskIds参数必须二选一进行配置，如果两个参数同时都不配置，则会报错
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instance refresh tasks that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询实例刷新任务的 ID
parameters.name: instance_refresh_task_ids
